context: Sho and Hina kick a ball around the yard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、サッカー、一緒に、する？
lines.en: Hina — want to play soccer together?
lines.style: Soft, hesitant opening. Small voice, genuinely curious. Warm and inviting without demanding. Lets the question hang gently, as if ready to be okay with any answer.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah — I can kick the ball!
lines.style: Bright, immediate delight. Unguarded enthusiasm from deep in her chest. Quick tempo, vowels open and clear. The joy of being asked and being able to say yes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 頑張って、シュート、する。
lines.en: I'm going to try hard with my shot.
lines.style: Determined but soft-spoken. Quiet focus threading through each word. Slow, deliberate pace. Small body gathering itself with sincere effort.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: すごい！上手だね、しょう。
lines.en: That was amazing! You're so good, Sho.
lines.style: Bright admiration, genuine and unselfconscious. Quick, warm delivery. Genuine pride in her friend — no hesitation, pure childish appreciation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、サッカー、楽しい。
lines.en: Playing soccer together is so much fun.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Reflective, like he's noticing this moment as it happens. Soft warmth spreading through the words. Gentle trailing-off, savoring the simplicity of it.
